reviews.text: We have had our Complete Outdoor Living Pool for a few years now with no major issues. I have to say we enjoy it very much. There are a lot of shady contractors out there, so beware! Complete Outdoor Living Pools and Spas are top-notch, very professional, and provide excellent customer service. If you have never worked with a contractor, just know there will be times when it seems like nothing is happening, but no worries with this company. The two young men who came out were very patient with all my questions and went above and beyond to make sure we were happy. As stated, it's been several years now, and I feel comfortable recommending Complete Outdoor Living Pools and Spas to anyone.
reviews.author: Bryan Goble

reviews.text: We love our pool!  The compete experience with COL was exceptional.  We were referred to COL.  Matt, Andrew, Austin, and Nathan were super friendly and helpful throughout the entire process.  From the very first exploratory visit to post construction follow-up calls and general pool maintenance questions, Matt was always available and attentive.  This was our first pool and we were very anxious about the original pool design and pricing process.  Matt and Andrew were very patient and applied zero sales pressure.  They listened to our every need and want and ultimately helped design the perfect pool and patio for us.  Austin and Nathan were super flexible and communicative throughout the build process.  We’ve delayed building a pool for years due to fear of the build process and pool builders.  The team at COL were amazing!
reviews.author: Lisa Tuttle

reviews.text:
COL did an excellent job on our pool.   This was our first inground pool, and we were a little nervous about the process.   Matt and his crew were very easy to work with and became like family by the time the pool was finished.   We were extremely pleased with the whole process.  They were so patient with us and addressed ALL of our questions and concerns as new pool owners.   I am taking care of my pool myself, so they walked me through pool school with baby steps and came out any time I called with an issue that I couldn't solve on my own.   Our neighbors even used them when they saw how easy our process went.
If you’re looking for a new pool or outdoor living area, please don’t hesitate to reach out to them…you’ll be glad you did!
reviews.author: Dionne Zschiesche

reviews.text: We had our outdoor living space and pool built last year by this family owned business and I must say that I am so glad that we decided to go with COL. In every step of the construction phase, we were provided with details on what to expect. Austin is a wealth of knowledge when it comes to the construction phase. He was always helpful with answering  the many questions I had during and after the construction phase and always had a pleasant attitude. From the designing phase, to the dig, to the final completion date, Matt and Austin were always there to offer suggestions and provide their expertise when we weren't sure or hesitant about our options. They didn't treat us like another project to get done but rather treated us with such great respect and never made us feel rushed and in my opinion, apart from the quality of the project , their customer service sets them apart from any other pool company. It's been several months since they completed our project and it's such a pleasant feeling to hear from COL to ask how everything was going with our outdoor living space. They are great! I would definitely use them again in the future and would highly recommend them to anyone who is looking to have an outdoor pool or outdoor living area built.  Below are pics of the before and after.
reviews.author: Ana

reviews.text: We loved our experience with Complete Outdoor Living! They were the first people we got a quote from and no one beat their prices or ideas - there were many things that other builders charged extra for that COL included in the base price.  My husband was the one taking notes on the equipment and found that COL used the best.  I was in charge of aesthetics. Matt has a great eye for this! I knew I wanted a ledge for our pool...Matt made sure the placement was so that it provided the best view from the where we'd be sitting inside and out. It was little things like that that made COL stand out - he looked out for us to make sure we had an investment we'd love for a long time.  He understood our budget and made suggestions that would give us the best bang for our buck.  Austin was wonderful during the construction. He kept us updated with how things were progressing and if there were any hold-ups or hiccups. He explained everything that was going on and patiently addressed all our questions (of which there were many...sorry Austin!) Their follow-through and follow-up are wonderful.
reviews.author: Stephanie Shackelford

reviews.text: Love, Love, Love my backyard oasis!!!  I cannot express how pleased I am with a job well done.  It was done timely, efficiently and professionally!
reviews.author: Janet Nabors

reviews.text: Awesome family oriented business! They were honest and fair, and handled any issues immediately; they even followed up to make sure that we were happy with the results. I've recommended them to my friends and they feel the same. I cannot say enough good things about this company because they obviously take pride in doing it right. I'm very critical when it comes to customer service, and they've far surpassed any of my expectations!  Great owners, great employees, great company!
reviews.author: Robert Brown

reviews.text: We did our homework for quite some time before making our decision on a pool builder. Complete Outdoor Living Pools & Spas was HIGHLY recommended by 3 families in our neighborhood and they were 💯 RIGHT in their recommendation. Matt & Austin were so easy to work with. They made the process for such a big decision like putting in a pool go so smoothly from start to finish. The communication with this company was impeccable!!! We were kept updated with ALL phases of the build. Once the pool was complete they continued to follow up with us and be available for our questions as new pool owners. They educated us thoroughly on equipment, chemicals, supplies and every detail for maintenance. We have so enjoyed our pool. This company needs more than 5 stars ⭐️ when it comes to the BEST CUSTOMER SERVICE!!! Don’t look anywhere else for your pool, spa or patio needs but Complete Outdoor Living Pools & Spas.
reviews.author: Tammy Clark
